landing.tagline: It's not about who wins, but who loses. Kerala's favourite card game, played with friends.
landing.playHint: No accounts. No install. Just share the link.
landing.howSubtitle: Two to ten players. Get rid of your cards before everyone else does.

steps.title: Deal it all out
steps.body: The whole deck goes around, as evenly as it can. Whoever holds the Ace of Spades opens.

steps.title: Follow suit
steps.body: Lead a card. Everyone must follow that suit if they have it. Highest card takes the round and leads the next one.

steps.title: Vettu!
steps.body: No card in that suit? Throw anything. The round stops right there, and the highest card of the led suit picks up the whole pile.

steps.title: Don't be last
steps.body: Empty your hand and you're safe. The last one still holding cards is the Kazhutha.

rules.title: Deck and ranking
rules.body: A standard 52-card deck, no jokers. Ace is highest, then K, Q, J, 10 and on down to 2.

rules.title: Dealing
rules.body: Every card is dealt. If it doesn't split evenly, a few players get one extra. That's just how it goes.

rules.title: Opening
rules.body: The player holding the Ace of Spades leads the first round. The host decides whether they must lead the Ace itself or may open with any card.

rules.title: Turn order
rules.body: Play goes around in the same order all game. Only who leads changes.

rules.title: A normal round
rules.body: Everyone follows the led suit if they can. Once all have played, the highest card of that suit wins. Those cards are discarded and the winner leads next.

rules.title: Vettu
rules.body: Can't follow suit? Play any card. That's a vettu. The round ends immediately, the remaining players are skipped, and whoever has the highest card of the led suit on the table collects everything played. They lead the next round.

rules.title: Getting out
rules.body: You're out, and safe, when you play your last card in a round that finishes without a vettu. If someone vettus on your last card and yours is the highest of the led suit, you collect the pile and you're back in.

rules.title: The Kazhutha
rules.body: Play on until only one player still has cards. That's the Kazhutha. The donkey.

landing.p2pBody: Your browser talks directly to your friends' browsers over WebRTC. A tiny signaling server only introduces players to each other. It never sees a single card.
landing.lightBody: Loads in a blink, runs on any phone, and installs as an app if you want it to. No ads, no logins, no nonsense.
landing.openBody: Free, and all of it is on GitHub. Read it, fork it, host your own table.
